title: A Tale of Valour: Major Somnath Sharma
subject: English
summary: “A Tale of Valour: Major Somnath Sharma” is an inspiring chapter about the bravery and sacrifice of Major Somnath Sharma, the first recipient of the Param Vir Chakra, India's highest military honour. He was a brave Indian Army officer who fought fearlessly during the 1947–48 war in Kashmir. Despite being injured, he continued to lead his soldiers and defend the country against enemy forces. His courage and leadership helped protect the Srinagar airfield from being captured by the enemy. He sacrificed his life while performing his duty. Major Somnath Sharma is remembered as a true hero of India. The chapter teaches us that we should be courageous, patriotic and dedicated to our duties.
